name: Home Maintenance Hub
install: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; git submodule update --init --recursive; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi; export PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"; if ! command -v just >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl --proto '"'"'=https'"'"' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://just.systems/install.sh | bash -s -- --to "${HOME}/.local/bin"; fi; uv sync --group dev; uv run streamlit skills --yes; mkdir -p .cursor/skills; ln -sfn "$(readlink .agents/skills/developing-with-streamlit)" .cursor/skills/developing-with-streamlit 2>/dev/null || true'
